name: Silver Spoon
description: Spoon-fed heroes: bonuses that grow every level, unlimited secondary skills, and one Supremacy skill for all four magic schools.
author: An Bui

1.1.1: Unlimited Secondary Skills: every learnable skill is offered at each level-up (was 2), including up to 6 upgrades of skills the hero already has; use the arrows in the level-up window to browse them
Supremacy: heroes from other mods who start with an elemental magic skill now get Supremacy instead, and any Fire, Air, Water or Earth Magic handed out by a map also becomes Supremacy
1.1.0: Level Scaling: +20% experience gain per level now starts at level 1
Level Scaling: primary skills changed from +1 per level to a flat +25% to all four
Level Scaling: Spell Power and Knowledge no longer stack with a hero's own specialty, like the other bonuses
New submod Supremacy: one skill replaces Fire, Air, Water and Earth Magic and gives all four schools at its level, with new iron, silver and gold crown icons
1.0.3: Level Scaling: every per-level bonus starts at level 2, so level 1 heroes keep their normal stats and abilities
1.0.2: Level Scaling: a bonus is skipped for heroes whose specialty already gives the same bonus (previously only experience)
1.0.1: Level Scaling: land movement +10% per level (was +2%), new +100 sea movement points per level, rough terrain costs 50 fewer movement points per tile
1.0.0: Initial release: Level Scaling, Unlimited Secondary Skills
